# Local image tools: attribution

ONNX Runtime Web (Microsoft contributors) uses the MIT license. Transformers.js (Hugging Face contributors) uses Apache-2.0. PPU Paddle OCR (snowfluke contributors) uses MIT. Bundled JavaScript retains emitted dependency notices. License texts are in `licenses/` beside this file.

PP-OCRv6 Tiny, PP-LCNet document orientation and the published UVDoc ONNX conversion are distributed by snowfluke/ppu-paddle-ocr-models under Apache-2.0. PP-DocLayoutV3 is published by PaddlePaddle under Apache-2.0. Table Transformer (Microsoft; Xenova ONNX conversion) and Florence-2-base-ft (Microsoft; onnx-community conversion) are MIT. Exact repository revisions, file hashes and sizes are recorded in `model-manifest.json`. Source and license links are also visible before installation.

Model files are unmodified conversions from their pinned upstream repositories. Carpe Noctum adds local execution, proposal conversion, caching and review controls. No model owns or verifies the RF calculations. Use the model repository for its complete model card and training-data limitations.

License text sources: Apache Software Foundation LICENSE-2.0; Microsoft onnxruntime v1.23.2 LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices (reference notices; runtime is pinned separately by package-lock.json); installed ppu-paddle-ocr and @huggingface/transformers packages. Additional bundled dependency notices are retained by esbuild.
